zoe: Quick note — ran onboarding smoke for onyx-7b-int4 against GTN long-context slices. Summary: ~48% token compute reduction vs int6, median latency 110ms -> 82ms, p95 490ms -> 360ms. EM overall 0.918 -> 0.902 (drop 1.6 pts). Long-context (>2500 tokens) EM drop ~4.9 pts and a few hallucination clusters on extraction. Need a short ops plan for product/GTN.

matt: can we get per-intent deltas? especially multi-doc summarization and timeline extraction.

zoe: snapshot: s3://internal/onyx7b/2026-03-22/summary.json. Quick split: search +0.1, summarization -3.9, extraction -2.8, code -0.4.

anika: likely accumulation of quant noise in KV cache. Ops recs: 1) start 4% canary with full shadowing to int6 for slices; 2) enable sticky KV cache routing so warmed sessions stay on int6; 3) add a lightweight saliency precheck to reroute multi-doc summaries. Example rule: {"rule":"prefix_saliency","entities":">=6","fallback":"onyx-7b-int6","canary":4}.

ren: on quant experiments: try (A) per-layer outlier clipping + compensated dequant (adds ~7% cost), (B) mixed-precision preserving first/last 3 layers at int6 (adds ~11%). Run both as parallel shadows during canary.

anika: monitoring: set alerts for EM delta >=1.2 pts on critical slices and hallucination absolute increase >0.4%. Deploy-bot can you start the canary and attach shadows for A/B?

deploy-bot: Canary started: onyx-7b-int4 @ 4% traffic. Shadowing enabled to onyx-7b-int6. Experiments A and B attached as shadows. Metrics: gtn_em, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, token_entropy. Alerts configured: em_delta_critical >= 1.2, hallucination_delta >= 0.4%.

matt: I'll open infra/eng-ml#1368 with snapshots and failing prompts (redacted). Priors: if mixed-precision B recovers >75% EM with cost <12% we promote to 30% and reassess.

zoe: product is ok with 4% canary for 48h. We'll run a 1k priming-entropy probe overnight too. I'll post results to the ticket. Keep slack updates minimal.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: on deploy-bot message)
